subject: Hosted API: pilot and baseline options for low-volume proof-of-value

Subject: Hosted API: pilot and baseline options for low-volume proof-of-value

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call this morning — good to meet briefly. Per our conversation, you mentioned Acme's early experiment will be low-volume for Q4 (roughly 50k–200k inference tokens/month across a handful of storefront queries) but you want predictable economics and a path to scale without committing to Dedicated capacity yet.

I pulled together a few concrete paths we typically use for customers in this situation. Attached is the Starter Pack ratecard (pdf) and a short SOW template for a 90‑day pilot. High-level options: 

- Option A — Pure Pay-as-you-go: no monthly minimum, standard hosted unit pricing. Good for exploration but less protection on price as you scale.
- Option B — Starter Baseline: small monthly guarantee (we typically start at $1,200/mo) that gives a 20% blended discount vs PAYG + a $500 activation credit applied to the first invoice. Protects rate for predictable bursts.
- Option C — Time-boxed Pilot (90 days): prepaid credit ($3k) that converts 50% into a baseline credit if you convert to a 6‑ or 12‑month commit within 30 days after the pilot.

A few questions that will help us recommend a tighter band: expected token mix (short chat prompts vs long generation), peak qps tolerance (p95 latency target), and whether billing should be via PO or card.

If you want, Aditya can propose a short configuration and cost table tomorrow.

Best,
Tessa

--

Thanks Tessa — very helpful summary. A couple clarifying items from our side: 

1) 50k–200k tokens/month is a loose range; most of our queries are short (catalog lookups + 1–2 sentence generative snippets).
2) Procurement will want a path that limits our exposure — they don't want open-ended invoices without a floor. But they're open to a small baseline if we can get an activation credit and a capped overage rate.
3) We use ProcureCloud for POs; I'll loop Lisa from procurement on next steps.

Please go ahead and have Aditya recommend exact numbers for Option B and C (we care about month 1 effective price). Also — can you confirm whether Starter Baseline includes access to streaming and function-calling without extra fees?

Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the details. Short answers up-front: streaming and function-calling are part of our hosted API across all commercial tiers; no add-on line item for those features. Below is a compact proposal tuned to your usage profile (short prompts, low QPS):

Proposal (estimates) — Acme Retail
- PAYG: $0.0008 per output token; no monthly minimum. Good if you want zero commitment.
- Starter Baseline (recommended for procurement comfort): $1,500/month guarantee — this covers ~180k output tokens equivalent at the PAYG rate but we apply a 20% blended discount so effective unit = $0.00064/output token; we also add a $600 activation credit on first invoice. Overage beyond the baseline is billed at PAYG but with a hard cap: during the first 3 months, overage rate capped at 1.25x PAYG.
- 90-day Pilot: Prepay $3,000 credit for the pilot period. If you convert to a 6‑ or 12‑month commit within 30 days, 50% of the prepayment converts to the first-month baseline credit; otherwise credit is used against usage only.

Operational notes:
- Billing: we can do PO-based invoicing (Net30) for Starter Baseline and Pilot.
- SLA & Escalation: baseline customers get access to our priority support channel and an initial onboarding call with the Customer Reliability Engineer (CRE).
- Data handling: hosted API, standard retention and opt-out — we can sign the standard DPA and include SOC 2 evidence on request.

I've attached the Starter Pack ratecard (v3) and a sample SOW for the pilot. Grace is copied to help with onboarding and procurement artifacts. If this looks acceptable I'll draft an order form and attach it to a DocuSign.

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
